Fixes bug B-dup-check-sibling-template-tasks: Filing ATF-junie-descriptor, ATF-continue-descriptor and ATF-zed-descriptor with the same title pattern as ATF-kiro-descriptor was refused as a possible duplicate (score 0.68-0.79) although each is a different agent; every add needed --new, and the refusal printed the answer command four times identically. Sibling per-agent tasks differ only by the agent name, which the similarity score underweights. Found on DRV-decide.

Write the regression test first and watch it FAIL on the unfixed code; then `ddflow complete fix-B-dup-check-sibling-template-tasks --regression-test <test>` closes the bug with the task (or `ddflow bug fixed B-dup-check-sibling-template-tasks --regression-test <test>` first).
data.title: Fix bug B-dup-check-sibling-template-tasks: duplicate check refuses sibling tasks filed from one template

import sys,json; sys.path.insert(0,'.'); import ddflow.services.similar as S; from ddflow.core import textsim
CORPUS=[json.loads(l) for l in open('tests/fixtures/dedupe/corpus.jsonl') if l.strip()]
# real-corpus IDF: name tokens df=1 already at the ceiling; sibling score stays >0.55

data.reason: False finding at the similarity engine. (1) The distinguishing per-agent token is already maximal-weight, not underweighted: against the real corpus IDF, 'junie'/'kiro'/'zed' have df=1 (idf 6.77, the ceiling), yet siblings still score 0.72-0.77 because ~40 shared boilerplate tokens outweigh one name token -- no IDF tweak lowers that below ask_threshold without regressing the D-no-duplicates eval bar (title-boost keeps them ~0.72; verified by simulation). The residual refusal is the DESIGNED 'ask' behaviour (R-dedupe-matchers: no score can tell a different instance of the same template from a duplicate; --new is the documented answer), and the semantic remedy is tracked as B-semantic-recall. (2) The 'printed the answer command four times identically' symptom is already fixed in 0.2.10: Bf29855c414 (commit 3a140e1c9) replaced repeated ready-commands with one 'Answer it:' line in ddflow/api/_dedupe_reason.py.

data.body:
Fixes bug B-session-prompt-no-relay-attribution: Operator answers reach a subagent through the coordinator; ddflow session prompt has no field for relayed-by, so the log cannot distinguish the operator's own words from a relay. Found on DRV-decide.

Write the regression test first and watch it FAIL on the unfixed code; then `ddflow complete fix-B-session-prompt-no-relay-attribution --regression-test <test>` closes the bug with the task (or `ddflow bug fixed B-session-prompt-no-relay-attribution --regression-test <test>` first).
data.title: Fix bug B-session-prompt-no-relay-attribution: session prompt cannot mark a prompt as relayed by a coordinator

data.claim: The session.prompt path drops relay provenance: ddflow/services/sessions/_record.py::prompt writes only text/item/redactions, so a relay is indistinguishable from the operator's own words. Adding relayed_by to that event and folding it makes the distinction recordable.
data.falsifier: A relayed prompt's event data shows no non-empty relayed_by distinct from a direct prompt's.
data.mechanism: prompt() accepts relayed_by, appends it to the session.prompt event data; _h_session_prompt folds it; api.session_prompt and both surfaces pass it; the CLI flag --relayed-by sets it, empty means direct.
data.probe: ddflow session prompt <sid> --text x --relayed-by coord-1 ; read the session.prompt event data
data.question: Can a ddflow session prompt record that it was relayed by a coordinator, so the log tells a relay from the operator's own words?

evidence.note: RESEARCH R3f07337b0b CONFIRMED: added relayed_by to session.prompt event + fold + both surfaces; probe shows relayed->relayed_by:'coord-1' vs direct->relayed_by:''

ddflow brief --item showed the rules digest; change is a small, config-free wiring of one field through appends/fold/surfaces; obeys r-everything-configurable (no new hard-coded tunable) and r-small-files. Commit 7892cb5be.

Added relayed_by through ddflow/services/sessions/_record.py::prompt (event data), ddflow/core/handlers/sessions.py::_h_session_prompt (fold), ddflow/api/knowledge/sessions.py::session_prompt, surfaces/declared/records.py (--relayed-by Param) and surfaces/commands/knowledge.py (cmd_session). Regression test tests/test_session_prompt_relayed_by.py. Commit 7892cb5be.
